name: Rosalind's Folio
author: kolache
description: A castle library staged like a painted visual novel: candlelit by night, sunlit by day. Long replies set like a book page (about 70 characters a line, pinned speaker, scene-break ornaments), a gilt frame on the page you are reading, and a walnut-and-gilt VN dialogue box. Suggests Follow time of day (07:00 light, 19:00 dark). Fonts: EB Garamond and Cinzel (SIL OFL 1.1).
